visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a grey one-shoulder ribbed tank top and star-shaped silver earrings, stands against a white background featuring a shelving unit filled with perfumes, designer bags, and small figurines. She points her right index finger upward while looking directly at the camera, her facial expression animated and welcoming in bright, even studio-style lighting that eliminates harsh shadows on her face. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a clear square makeup compact labeled "muice MULTI POWDER" in gold lettering. The woman's manicured hand holds the object steady against the blurred background of her grey top, showcasing the smooth, pale yellow texture of the pressed powder inside the transparent plastic casing. (3) Back to a medium shot, she holds the product near her chin, pointing at it with her right index finger while talking excitedly. Her mouth moves in rapid speech, and her eyes are bright with enthusiasm. The background shelving remains visible, containing luxury items like a Dior bag and various skincare bottles. (4) An extreme close-up of the woman’s face shows her using a thin, gold-handled makeup brush to apply the light powder to the side of her nose and directly under her right eye. Her eyes focus slightly off-camera as she carefully dabs the product, demonstrating its matte effect on her skin. (5) She uses a small, white triangular sponge to dab the area under her left eye, looking closely at the camera to show the texture. Her skin appears uniform and bright. In the background, the soft white lighting reflects off the glass shelves of the display unit behind her. (6) A split-screen comparison appears with a vertical divider. On the left side, labeled "Before," her skin shows natural shadows; on the right side, labeled "After," the area under her eyes looks brighter and more even. She gestures with her hands toward her face to highlight the difference. (7) The woman swatches the powder onto the back of her right hand using her left finger. The camera captures the fine, silk-like texture of the product as it blends into her skin. She then holds the product again, smiling widely and gesturing toward her face with both hands in a concluding motion.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 【爆紅實驗室EP4】. (2) [Slogan]: muice多用用途粉. (3) [Subtitle]: 終於被我買到啦. (4) [Subtitle]: 01跟02都是比較偏粉調. (5) [Subtitle]: 那我買的是比較適合自然暖膚色的03米黃色. (6) [Subtitle]: 它可以拿來修飾斑點、毛孔. (7) [Subtitle]: 也可以畫出這種自然的臥蠶. (8) [Subtitle]: 不過我自己最喜歡的就是拿它來修飾我的黑眼圈、淚溝. (9) [Subtitle]: 像我的底妝眼妝都完成之後呢. (10) [Subtitle]: 低頭你會發現眼頭這邊還是稍微有一塊陰影黑黑的. (11) [Subtitle]: 這時我會拿出手指絨毛粉撲輕輕的撲上. (12) [Subtitle]: 它就可以有修飾加定妝的效果讓你的面中看起來更平整. (13) [Variety]: Before After. (14) [Subtitle]: 你看有上跟沒上是不是差很多!. (15) [Subtitle]: 那也可以順便稍微帶到一下眼尾這暗沈的部分. (16) [Subtitle]: 它的粉質本身就帶有一點緞光感. (17) [Subtitle]: 所以即使上在眼下也不會有那種厚粉的感覺. (18) [Slogan]: 一顆只要200多塊我覺得價格真的很佛. (19) [Subtitle]: 花少少的錢就可以讓你的妝容變得更精緻!.
